standard_prerequisites: the completion functor from the chapter's construction and its full faithfulness lemma (counted earlier in this lane)
rig-etale morphisms of formal algebraic spaces and the algebraization lemma for affine rig-etale targets
the smash construction away from T producing formal completions of etale covers
etale equivalence relations and the bootstrap theorem producing quotient algebraic spaces
compatibility of completion with fibre products and quotient sheaves
core_obligations: Prove that when X is affine the completion functor of the chapter is an equivalence, i.e. every locally Noetherian formal algebraic space W over X_{/T} with a rig-etale morphism to X_{/T} is isomorphic to X'_{/T} for some algebraic space X' etale over X away from T
proof_roadmap: Full faithfulness is the earlier completion-functor lemma; it remains to prove essential surjectivity for a rig-etale g : W to X_{/T}
Step 1, W affine: the algebraization lemma gives a finite-type etale-over-X-minus-T scheme U with U_{/T} isomorphic to W, and the smash construction puts it in the essential image

Step 2, W separated: cover W by the W_i of the formal-space definition; the W_i and the double fibre products W_i x_W W_j are affine, hence in the essential image, and full faithfulness yields morphisms t_ij and s_ij matching the projections; the coproducts form an etale equivalence relation (V,R,s,t) on X, whose quotient X' exists by the bootstrap theorem, and completion commutes with fibre products and quotient sheaves so X'_{/T} is isomorphic to W
Step 3, W general: the W_i and W_i x_W W_j are separated, hence in the essential image by Step 2, and the same equivalence-relation argument exhibits W as a completion
difficulty_reason: H2: a three-step essential surjectivity argument in the style of descent; each step is written out, the heaviest being the equivalence-relation gluing in Step 2.
